210c5c7930cb628e.description: Company: SAN International Group Location: Jeddah, Saudi Arabia Department: Marketing & Digital Commerce About SAN International SAN International is a Saudi multi-brand group operating in the fashion and lifestyle sector. We develop distinctive brands, products, and seamless customer experiences that combine style, creativity, and gifting appeal, connecting with our customers through physical retail stores and digital commerce channels. About the Role We are looking for a creative, trend-driven, and highly motivated Social Media Content Creator who can turn ideas into engaging, visually compelling content that captures attention, tells stories, and strengthens our brands' digital presence. The ideal candidate has a strong passion for fashion, lifestyle, and digital storytelling, with the ability to create original content that resonates with audiences, reflects each brand's identity, and contributes to measurable engagement and business results. You will collaborate closely with Social Media, Brand Strategy, Creative Production, and Digital Commerce teams to develop content across multiple platforms and support campaigns, product launches, and brand activations. Key Responsibilities Create engaging, original, and platform-specific content for Instagram, TikTok, Snapchat, and other social media channels. Develop creative concepts, storytelling ideas, short-form videos, Reels, and behind-the-scenes content. Plan, shoot, and edit high-quality mobile-first content aligned with each brand's identity. Stay ahead of emerging social media trends, viral formats, and audience behaviors. Translate product features, seasonal campaigns, and brand messages into compelling visual stories. Collaborate with creative, marketing, and e-commerce teams to execute content strategies and product launches. Participate in content production, photoshoots, events, and brand activations. Monitor content performance and continuously optimize creative approaches to improve reach, engagement, and conversions. Maintain consistency in brand tone, visual identity, and content quality across all platforms. Qualifications & Requirements 2–4 years of experience in social media content creation, preferably within fashion, lifestyle, accessories, beauty, retail, or e-commerce. Strong portfolio demonstrating creative storytelling, short-form video production, and engaging social media content. Proven ability to create content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and Snapchat. Hands-on experience in mobile photography, videography, and video editing. Proficiency in tools such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar editing applications. Strong understanding of social media trends, platform algorithms, and audience engagement. Creative mindset with excellent visual storytelling and attention to detail. Ability to work in a fast-paced, multi-brand retail environment. Strong collaboration, time management, and communication skills. Familiarity with AI-powered content creation tools is an advantage. What We Value At SAN International, we value individuals who take ownership, embrace creativity, move with agility, and continuously strive for excellence. We are looking for someone who doesn't just follow trends but knows how to turn them into meaningful brand experiences and impactful content. Join SAN International If you are passionate about storytelling, social media, fashion, and creating content that makes brands stand out, we would love to hear from you. Apply now and be part of a team shaping the future of fashion and lifestyle experiences.

21142c8c3a112817.description: About the Role Al Khozama Investment is seeking an Italian-Speaking Host for a full-time position. This role focuses on providing a professional and personalized welcome to all guests, with a particular emphasis on supporting Italian-speaking visitors. The Host serves as the initial point of contact, ensuring a positive arrival experience that aligns with the restaurant's identity and hospitality standards. Key Responsibilities Welcome and greet guests in a friendly, professional, and engaging manner. Communicate fluently with Italian-speaking guests and assist them throughout their arrival. Manage guest arrivals and coordinate with the host team regarding reservations and seating arrangements. Open doors and assist guests with entering and exiting the restaurant premises. Maintain a strong and professional presence at the restaurant entrance at all times. Respond to guest inquiries and provide accurate information about the restaurant. Ensure a seamless guest experience through effective coordination with the front-of-house team. Handle guest requests professionally and escalate any concerns to management as needed. Maintain excellent grooming, appearance, and professional conduct in accordance with establishment standards. Required Qualifications and Skills Previous experience in luxury restaurants, hotels, or premium hospitality establishments is preferred. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are essential for this role. Strong guest relations and customer service orientation. Confident, well-presented, approachable, and personable demeanor. Ability to work effectively in a dynamic and multicultural hospitality environment. Demonstrated understanding of luxury service standards and guest expectations. Work Environment This full-time position operates within a dynamic hospitality setting, requiring active engagement with guests and coordination with a diverse front-of-house team. The role demands a consistent professional presence and adherence to high service standards. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply for this role.

21ed05d58253bbf9.description: About the Role HolyStar Arabia is seeking a Senior Quality Inspector to join our team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves coordinating and performing electrical inspections and testing activities across In-Process Quality Control (IPQC) and Final Quality Control (FQC) to ensure product conformity and effective control of nonconformities before final release. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this position is to ensure the quality and conformity of products through meticulous electrical inspections and testing. The Senior Quality Inspector plays a critical role in identifying and addressing nonconformities, thereby upholding product standards prior to customer delivery. Key Responsibilities Coordinate and perform daily electrical inspection and testing activities. Review technical documentation including drawings, Bills of Material (BOMs), specifications, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), and acceptance criteria. Conduct factory routine tests, functional testing, and dielectric testing. Review inspection reports and test records to ensure accuracy and completeness. Coordinate Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and customer/witness inspections. Initiate and follow up on Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) and verify the implementation of corrective actions. Provide technical guidance and support to QC Inspectors and Testing Technicians. Coordinate with Production and Engineering departments to effectively resolve quality-related issues. Ensure proper calibration, traceability, and control of all QC records. Escalate significant or recurring quality issues to QC management for further action. Meet established targets for standard QC hours allocated per product type. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in quality inspection, particularly within electrical testing and control. A strong understanding of quality control processes and technical documentation is essential for this role. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring on-site presence to manage and execute inspection and testing activities effectively. Application Process HolyStar Arabia invites qualified candidates to apply for this Senior Quality Inspector position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

2137c20a6598ca99.description: About the Role Parsons is seeking a Construction Manager to join its team in Makkah and Jeddah. This full-time role involves leading a multi-disciplined team to accomplish assigned construction management tasks, leveraging extensive knowledge in the field. The Construction Manager will be responsible for overseeing program-wide construction management for attractions and entertainment-based projects. Key Responsibilities Strategize, lead, and oversee all facets of program-wide construction management for attractions/entertainment-based projects. Develop comprehensive plans that support organizational and project objectives, effectively allocating resources and time across design and construction phases. Direct the PMC team to ensure work is delivered safely, on schedule, and with high quality, meeting contract documents, relevant codes, and standards. Direct the overall planning of construction activities to identify critical milestones and priorities. Determine budget estimates and staffing requirements for the defined scope and schedule. Ensure the availability of subcontractors and major construction equipment at appropriate times for maximum efficiency and productivity. Establish assignments for Construction Superintendents, monitor progress, and recommend corrective actions. Conduct performance evaluations and recommend promotions and salary actions. Manage the assignment of manpower, materials, and equipment to maximize efficiency, maintain schedules, and meet budget goals. Anticipate and resolve problems such as scope changes, schedule slippage, and budget overruns. Ensure critical milestones are met for each project phase. Ensure the use of sound construction practices to attain required quality control at maximum efficiency and minimum cost. Prepare periodic reports summarizing construction activity progress for management and clients, including formal presentations. Ensure effective implementation of all company and client policies and procedures, including labor relations policies. Serve as the primary contact with client representatives, subcontractors, and government representatives for construction-related activities. Maintain strong client and community relations, including making presentations to local civic organizations. Perform other responsibilities associated with this position as appropriate. Qualifications and Experience Over 10 years of experience in construction management. A background with PMC (Project Management Consultancy) and Main Contractors is suitable. Experience in multiple projects involving theme park development, construction, show and ride systems design, or fabrication within the entertainment/theme park industry is preferred. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in the Makkah region, covering projects in both Jeddah and Makkah.

216b90d46ca580f1.description: About the Role GSK plc is seeking a Medical Representative to join their team in Dammam. This full-time role is designed for individuals with 0-1 years of experience and involves upholding GSK values by effectively engaging healthcare professionals (HCPs) in the assigned territory. The objective is to support patients in doing more, feeling better, and living longer through scientific discussions and tailored solutions. Role Purpose and Company Context The Medical Representative role emphasizes building trust, delivering solutions, and driving scientific discussions to ensure patient-centric care. GSK Saudi Arabia is committed to supporting Vision 2030 and the Saudi Arabian National Agenda, including Saudization, through the hiring, training, and development of Saudi National capabilities. GSK aims to deliver £40 billion in annual sales by 2031, focusing on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease. The company's diverse portfolio includes vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines, with a continuous focus on innovation and scientific excellence. Key Responsibilities Act as a trusted advisor to HCPs by providing tailored solutions and promoting GSK products, aligning with GSK’s patient-focused approach. Utilize approved promotional materials effectively while maintaining compliance with GSK policies, SOPs, and Saudi regulations. Conduct product detailing and scientific discussions with HCPs to support patient care. Organize and lead group doctor meetings to share medical insights and product information. Continuously gather market intelligence and provide timely feedback to optimize strategies. Qualifications and Requirements Attain and maintain GSK’s standards for product and disease knowledge. Complete annual certifications and adhere to all related SOPs, policies, and Saudi healthcare regulations. Meet defined efficiency and effectiveness KPIs, ensuring optimal execution of activities. Ensure proper care and use of GSK assets while optimizing company resources. Create and implement timely territory and call plans, tracking progress and outcomes. Achieve skill standards as measured by GSO (Good Sell Outcome) metrics. Execute all activities in compliance with GSK’s policies, procedures, and local regulations. Strive to achieve high levels of HCP satisfaction within the assigned territory. Work Environment This is a field-based role that requires regular travel across the assigned territory in Dammam. The position involves direct engagement with healthcare professionals in various settings.

216f9ec6b7141107.description: About the Role Marriott International is seeking a Laundry Attendant Supervisor for a full-time position in Jeddah. This role involves overseeing laundry operations, ensuring the efficient processing of items, and maintaining high standards of cleanliness and care for all articles. Key Responsibilities Operate and monitor washing, dry cleaning, and drying machinery, including adding chemicals and cleaning lint traps. Identify stained or damaged items and determine appropriate action for repair, spot treatment, rewash, or discard. Inspect the cleanliness of articles removed from machines and place them in clean linen carts. Set dryers to designated times and temperatures based on fabric types. Remove lint and debris from dryer screens, dry cleaning filters, and drain traps after each load. Fold cleaned articles to designated sizes, either by hand or using a folding machine. Maintain accurate records of laundered items. Operational Duties and Standards Adhere to all company safety and security policies and procedures, reporting accidents, injuries, and unsafe conditions to management. Ensure compliance with all company policies and procedures, maintaining a clean and professional uniform and personal appearance. Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information and protect company assets. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with colleagues, supporting team goals and responding appropriately to concerns. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards, identifying and recommending improvements for efficiency, productivity, quality, safety, and cost-savings. Physical Requirements Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines to identify defects. Stand, sit, or walk for extended periods or an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing up to 25 pounds without assistance. Navigate narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces, as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. About Delta Hotels by Marriott Delta Hotels by Marriott focuses on providing a seamless travel experience for modern frequent travelers, delivering essential needs and eliminating unnecessary elements. The brand emphasizes a warm, wise, and in-control approach, allowing guests to focus on what is most important. With a strong presence globally, Delta Hotels by Marriott is expanding rapidly. Joining Delta Hotels means becoming part of Marriott International's portfolio of brands, where individuals can contribute their best work and grow professionally.

21cb0ebbfdb10177.description: About the Role Duncan & Ross is seeking an Electrical Engineer to lead all electrical engineering activities related to the restoration of facility buildings and hangars. This full-time position is based in Riyadh and focuses on ensuring the safe and compliant restoration of power systems. Role Overview The Electrical Engineer will be responsible for overseeing the restoration of medium- and low-voltage (MV/LV) power systems, emergency power, and switchgear. This includes ensuring that all systems are safely restored, fully tested, and returned to service in strict adherence to approved designs, applicable codes, and company standards. Key Responsibilities Assess affected electrical systems on site and recommend appropriate repair or replacement solutions. Plan and coordinate power shutdowns and electrical isolations in liaison with Operations and HSE departments. Develop the electrical technical input for scopes of work, tender documents, and bills of quantities. Perform technical evaluations of bidder and contractor proposals. Review and approve designs, shop drawings, material submittals, and protection coordination studies. Supervise the installation, testing, energization, and commissioning of electrical systems. Monitor contractor performance, quality, and compliance with the approved scope and schedule. Verify and approve as-built drawings, test reports, and handover documentation. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Riyadh. The role involves working on-site to assess and supervise electrical system restoration projects. Application Process Candidates interested in this Electrical Engineer position are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

21fb7fd05c508b7a.job_title: Senior Executive Manager Business Enablement & Strategic Transaction
21fb7fd05c508b7a.description: About the Role Bupa Arabia is seeking a Senior Executive Manager Business Enablement & Strategic Transaction to join their team in Jeddah or Makkah. This full-time role involves reviewing and assuring commercial legal advice and strategic transaction support for Bupa Arabia and its subsidiaries. The objective is to ensure that legal solutions are commercially sound and align with the company's risk appetite. Key Responsibilities Oversee the section's workload, priorities, and resources, monitoring service delivery against established standards. Provide guidance to direct reports on daily legal work and priorities, and recommend functional plans and resource adjustments. Review commercial agreements, procurement contracts, and routine business matters, validating drafting and negotiated positions prior to execution. Assess contract risks and advise stakeholders on practical options, escalating terms that exceed agreed authority for approval. Manage legal support for investments, acquisitions, financing, and joint ventures, evaluating strategic partnership and subsidiary transactions for legal risk. Scrutinize transaction documents and legal due diligence reports, recommending transactions and closing documentation for approval. Identify legal and contractual risks in material engagements, evaluate risk exposure, and recommend mitigation strategies. Escalate material legal risks with clear recommendations for decision-making. Review complex legal work products for quality and consistency, verifying adherence to agreed legal standards. Recommend legal standards, positions, precedents, and templates for approval, and validate guidance notes before release. Team Leadership and Development Coach, mentor, and develop direct reports, appraising performance and recommending development plans. Encourage knowledge sharing and continuous improvement within the team. Recommend succession plans for critical roles to ensure continuity. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for this role should possess between 8 to 10 years of relevant experience in legal advisory, commercial contracting, and strategic transaction support. A strong understanding of legal risk management and quality assurance in a corporate environment is essential. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah, with the option to work from Jeddah. The role involves working within a dynamic legal team, providing critical support to Bupa Arabia and its subsidiaries.

21041113b7dad1ff.description: About Ma'aden and the Role Ma'aden, established in 1997, is a rapidly expanding multi-commodity mining and metals company in the Middle East. The company is focused on developing the mining industry as a key economic pillar for Saudi Arabia through an integrated mining value chain. This full-time role as Manager, Exploration, offers an opportunity to contribute to Ma'aden's growth and the future of mining in the Kingdom. Key Responsibilities The Manager, Exploration will serve as an active safety leader and be responsible for: Establishing, leading, and driving exploration work programs to achieve strategic targets and KPIs. Developing drilling strategies, plans, and budgets in collaboration with the Director of Exploration and other stakeholders, with an emphasis on identifying and delineating new mineral resources near existing mine sites. Providing technical frameworks, guidance, and peer review for exploration targets to site-based teams. Leading continuous improvement in understanding the economic geology of identified target areas. Interpreting drilling results and providing geological insights and recommendations for resource estimation, optimization, and development planning. Supporting the creation of a 5-year exploration overview, inventory delivery forecast, budget, and project pipeline advancement for Greenfields & Brownfields projects aligned with Ma'aden’s growth strategy. Creating and budgeting a detailed 2-year exploration work program to meet business commitments. Collaborating with stakeholders to ensure exploration plans are socially and environmentally responsible and adhere to land management governance standards. Tracking exploration performance against established KPIs and providing regular updates and analysis. Ensuring collaboration between technical teams, study and supporting cross-functional teams, and business partners to resolve execution challenges and leverage synergies. Updating and validating exploration programs in response to new data and economic, social, and environmental conditions. Applying and governing exploration systems and technical standards to ensure safe operations, productivity, and standard methodology. Supporting the ME group in desktop and field review of potential target areas, exploration properties, and early-stage projects aligned with the Company’s long-term goals. Applying an owner’s mindset to all elements of exploration to deliver efficient, smart, and faster exploration programs and target assessments. Team Leadership and Collaboration The role involves active team leadership and fostering a collaborative environment, including: Explaining team work purpose and value contribution to the business. Encouraging team members to identify critical issues affecting work. Allocating work to achieve team goals and reviewing performance. Recognizing and rewarding good work through feedback and coaching. Collaborating with the Director to build and develop the team, including recruitment and performance management. Reviewing decisions of Superintendents & Leads and correcting course as needed. Designing roles for team members working under Superintendents/Leads. Fostering an inclusive climate where team members feel safe to contribute, collaborate, and receive feedback. Qualifications and Requirements Candidates for this position should meet the following criteria: Over 13 years of relevant experience. Commitment to the highest standards of visible leadership in Health and Safety, Sustainability, and External Relations. Registration with a relevant professional body (*, AusIMM PGeo) or qualification for immediate registration. Work Environment and Travel This is a full-time position that requires frequent travel to BMNM CAGR exploration projects and/or mine sites.

211d978b6071e896.job_title: Reliability Engineer - Gasification & Power Generation Experience
211d978b6071e896.description: The Reliability Engineer is responsible for ensuring the reliability, availability, efficiency, and safety of equipment and systems used in gasification and power generation operations. The role focuses on implementing preventive and predictive maintenance strategies, investigating equipment failures, analyzing performance data, and driving continuous improvement initiatives to minimize downtime and optimize asset performance. If selected, the work location would be onsite at Jizan, Saudi Arabia. Responsibilities Monitor equipment performance and reliability, identifying potential risks and areas for improvement. Develop and implement preventive and predictive maintenance strategies to minimize equipment failures and unplanned downtime. Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and failure investigations to identify and address recurring equipment issues. Analyze equipment performance data, maintenance records, and reliability trends to recommend improvements. Apply reliability methodologies such as Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), and Total Productive Maintenance (TPM). Collaborate with operations and maintenance teams to improve equipment availability and operational efficiency. Ensure compliance with applicable safety, environmental, and industry standards. Prepare reliability reports, risk assessments, and recommendations for stakeholders. Identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives using reliability tools and emerging technologies. Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. 5–8 years of relevant experience in reliability engineering or maintenance management, preferably within the energy, gasification, power generation, or industrial sector. Strong understanding of reliability engineering principles, maintenance strategies, and equipment performance optimization. Experience with predictive maintenance techniques such as vibration analysis and thermography is an advantage. Knowledge of reliability methodologies, including RCA, RCM, FMEA, and TPM. Familiarity with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) and reliability analysis tools. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Good communication and reporting skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. Reliability-related certifications such as CRE or CMRP are an added advantage.

210f686778eb1e34.description: About DHL Global Forwarding DHL Global Forwarding, Freight (DGFF) is a specialist in air, ocean, and road freight within the Deutsche Post DHL Group, operating in over 220 countries. The company has been a pioneer in cross-border express shipping since 1969, offering standardized transport and specialized end-to-end solutions globally across various industries. The Role: OFR Specialist DHL Global Forwarding is seeking an OFR Specialist to join their team in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves managing ocean freight operations and customer service, ensuring efficient service delivery and contributing to business development. Key Responsibilities Build and develop trade lane consolidations for South African export traffic. Engage with the Global DGF network to promote and develop the Gateway for neighboring countries and local coastal branches. Coordinate day-to-day operations within the Airfreight Gateway. Assist and support the ACC Manager in rate and capacity procurement as required. Create and/or confirm transport orders, and perform and optimize bookings. Prepare, control, and distribute all required Import/Export documents. Identify performance issues of suppliers and propose solutions to improve performance. Update Customs shipment information and physical status, and resolve customer issues and incidents. Implement OFR Ops/CS plans and processes to provide ocean freight services for internal and external customers. Analyze and collate requirements for the freight control center, and support the operations team with necessary details, information, and instructions. Coordinate freight administration, including allocation and reservations of freight on planned line haul. Contribute to developing and executing plans for ocean freight products in areas such as perishables, pharmaceutical, and aviation. Identify opportunities to expand business with new clients and continuously improve in-house customer services. Build close business relationships with existing clients, conduct customer visits, and maintain customer retention. Stay updated on account performances, draft, and provide monthly reports to management. Implement pricing strategy and respond to pricing enquiries efficiently and competitively. Deliver day-to-day shipment documentation for freight forwarding, assist in the development of shipping tenders, and ensure on-time submission of relevant documents. Seek opportunities to enhance ocean freight productivity and efficient resource allocation and utilization. Analyze and provide input for processes and design systems to enhance service quality. Resolve and analyze issues in day-to-day delivery and implement practices for OFR Ops/CS focusing on increasing effectiveness and efficiency. Provide support, direction, and guidance to less experienced or new team members. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of relevant experience. Career Development DHL Global Forwarding offers opportunities for career development within a global company. The company is committed to fostering a positive work environment and supporting personal and professional growth, with a focus on developing talented women as part of its DGF Strategy 2025. About DHL As part of Deutsche Post DHL, the world's leading logistics provider, DHL Global Forwarding operates with a network of over 30,000 employees. The company holds a TOP EMPLOYER certification, recognizing its efforts in attracting and retaining talent. DHL Global Forwarding is an equal opportunity employer committed to becoming a leader in the forwarding industry through efficient processes, fast response times, and excellent customer service.

2144967063e6e901.description: About the Role TK Elevator is seeking an Elevator Electrical Product Development Engineer to join their team in Dammam, Eastern region. This full-time role is for a high-potential individual contributor with 2-5 years of experience, who will drive engineering excellence within the Product Development Centre. The position is designed for an individual motivated to progress into future leadership roles. Key Responsibilities The successful candidate will be responsible for the design, development, and lifecycle management of electrical systems and components for elevator products. This includes ensuring solutions are safe, innovative, manufacturable, cost-effective, and aligned with global engineering strategies. Support or lead the design, development, and validation of electrical systems, including power distribution, control systems, harnesses, and PCBAs. Ensure compliance with applicable safety and industry standards (*, UL, IEC, NEC). Drive innovation in electrical design, including the adoption of digital tools, automation, and emerging technologies. Oversee new product development and existing product enhancement activities across the full product lifecycle. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to achieve product performance, safety, quality, serviceability, and cost objectives. Prepare and maintain electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, interface definitions, and technical documentation. Evaluate and select electrical components, sensors, drives, safety devices, and control hardware. Define electrical architecture, component specifications, and design requirements. Drive system integration and technical alignment across mechanical, electrical, software, and systems engineering disciplines. Champion robust design practices, including electrical DFMEA, circuit simulation, prototyping, and testing. Ensure all electrical compliance with relevant elevator standards, regulations, and safety guidelines (*, IEC, EN, ASME, ISO, GB). Collaboration and Leadership This role requires the ability to influence outcomes, drive projects independently, and contribute to the development of engineering capabilities across the organization. The engineer will demonstrate potential for technical leadership and foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement. Show potential to develop into a technical lead through strong collaboration, decision-making, and stakeholder management skills. Collaborate closely with local and global engineering teams to define requirements, manage interfaces, and enable effective system integration. Partner with global engineering teams to share best practices, drive continuous improvements, and promote standardization. Support supplier qualification and component selection efforts in partnership with sourcing and quality teams. Qualifications and Requirements 2-5 years of experience in electrical engineering, preferably within product development. Strong technical expertise in electrical systems and components. Demonstrated leadership capabilities and motivation for career progression. Ability to influence outcomes and drive projects independently. Work Environment and Travel Ability to travel up to 30% domestically and internationally to support development centers, suppliers, and manufacturing facilities. Requires working in lab and test tower environments; adherence to all safety procedures and company safety standards is mandatory. Application Information Salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply.

21e5d549ba1b5ad5.company_name: مؤسسة حصه سليمان عيسى الفوزان التجارية
21e5d549ba1b5ad5.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مجمع ايرام الطبي عن فني مختبر طبي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إجراء الفحوصات المخبرية، وتشغيل وصيانة المعدات، وتقديم النتائج بدقة لضمان سير العمليات المخبرية بكفاءة وفعالية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تفقد وتشغيل وصيانة معدات حفظ وفحص العينات، وضبطها وفقاً لنوع الفحص المطلوب. دراسة طلبات الأطباء لتحديد الفحوصات المطلوبة، وسحب عينات الدم، واستلام عينات البول والبراز. تدوين بيانات المرضى على العينات وحفظها وفقاً لأسس الحفظ الصحيحة والمعتمدة. تحضير العينات للفحص والزراعة، واختيار مواد الفحص بالكميات والمواصفات المطلوبة. إجراء الفحوصات المختلفة والتحاليل الكيميائية والفيزيائية والمجهرية على العينات. استخراج النتائج وتوثيقها بدقة، وتقديمها للاختصاصي المشرف. إتلاف العينات المخبرية بعد الانتهاء من إجراء الفحوصات وتوثيق إجراءات الإتلاف. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المختبرات الطبية. القدرة على التعامل مع معدات المختبرات الطبية وتشغيلها وصيانتها. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات سحب العينات وتحضيرها وحفظها. القدرة على إجراء التحاليل المخبرية المختلفة بدقة. المهارات المطلوبة الدقة والانتباه للتفاصيل في جميع مراحل العمل المخبري. الالتزام بالبروتوكولات والإجراءات المعيارية للمختبر. مهارات جيدة في توثيق النتائج وإعداد التقارير. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتعاون مع الزملاء والاختصاصيين. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن بيئة مختبر طبي احترافية تلتزم بأعلى معايير الجودة والسلامة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

2189e2b4be199b0f.description: About El Seif Engineering Contracting Company El Seif Engineering Contracting Company operates with core values of excellence, integrity, and innovation. The company maintains high standards in project delivery, emphasizing precision and attention to detail. With over fifty years of experience across various industries, including public infrastructure, military, and defense, El Seif has developed expertise in managing complex challenges and delivering results. The company focuses on a forward-thinking approach to construction, aiming to create sustainable and impactful solutions. Role Overview: Project Manager (C&A) El Seif Engineering Contracting Company is seeking a Project Manager (C&A) to join its team. This full-time role involves overseeing project execution, managing teams, and ensuring compliance with company policies and project objectives. The successful candidate will contribute to the development of internal capabilities and maintain high standards of project delivery and client satisfaction. Key Responsibilities Manage the selection, retention, and development of Project Managers, including KSA national employees, to meet corporate objectives and Saudization targets. Provide input to Human Resources on succession planning, career growth, and organizational structure. Conduct team affairs with high standards of respect, integrity, accountability, agility, quality, safety, and corporate governance. Ensure compliance with the Code of Ethics policy and company values across all functions, fostering a strong people culture and ethical business practices. Oversee the adoption and utilization of systems and ERP within the function. Manage day-to-day project team responsibilities in accordance with business plans, company policies, and approved budgets. Monitor equipment availability and utilization at sites. Produce Bills of Quantities (BoQs) and manage support requirements for timely approvals. Identify and report unbudgeted or over-budgeted items and issue variation orders for scope changes. Obtain consultant approval for design, shop drawings, and material submittals. Report to the Project Director on the operational and financial status of projects. Assist the Project Director in preparing and implementing the Project Execution Plan (PEP). Manage project execution within budget and schedule, aiming for optimal client satisfaction. Design workforce histograms and monitor labor productivity, coordinating with HR for resource mobilization. Measure and report labor availability and implement trade productivity methods. Coordinate with the Procurement team to ensure high-quality material delivery. Support the preparation of reporting templates as per client requirements. Assist the Project Director in developing an Active Risk Management plan. Coordinate with the Engineering function for shop drawing generation. Support the Project Director in developing project work plans, assigning activities, and monitoring workflow. Manage project delivery and close-out in accordance with contractual arrangements and financial objectives. Prepare and present monthly project summary reports to the Project Director. Liaise with the Procurement function to develop and implement the project procurement plan. Develop staff, labor, and equipment mobilization and de-mobilization plans for optimal resource utilization. Support and implement strategies to achieve high client satisfaction and constructive relationships. Review monthly and quarterly cost reports for project review meetings. Develop, implement, and monitor project plans and controls, recommending changes and highlighting risks. Manage, evaluate, and reward the performance of the construction team, ensuring coordination with other functions. Work with suppliers and subcontractors to establish detailed project plans with key milestones. Prepare and deliver regular progress reports, including variance analysis. Manage the implementation of management policies, processes, and procedures to ensure compliance. Ensure compliance with safety, health, and environmental procedures, promoting a safe work environment and zero-tolerance policy. Display effective negotiation and persuasion skills with stakeholders to meet project objectives. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 15 years of experience in construction and project management. At least 5 years of experience in a managerial position within the construction and project management field. Work Type This is a full-time position.

212aa2e1ee20f084.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سمامة للتشغيل والادارة عن فني أجهزة طبية للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة الباحة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على متابعة تركيب وتشغيل الأجهزة الطبية، بالإضافة إلى تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية والعلاجية لضمان كفاءة عملها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تتبع مخططات تركيب الأجهزة الطبية المتنوعة مثل أجهزة غسل الكلى، وأجهزة دعم القلب والتنفس والرئة، وأجهزة التصوير والتخطيط الطبي. تحديد مواقع التركيب ومتابعة إجراءاته، وإعداد قوائم بقطع الغيار الاحتياطية الضرورية. متابعة إجراءات التشغيل التجريبي والتشغيل الفعلي للأجهزة الطبية وفقاً لأدلة التشغيل المعتمدة. تدريب مستخدمي الأجهزة الطبية على إجراءات التشغيل السليم والضبط الصحيح. تتبع مخططات الدارات الإلكترونية للأجهزة الطبية، وتشخيص الأعطال باستخدام أجهزة الفحص والقياس، وتنفيذ إجراءات الإصلاح والضبط اللازمة. تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة الطبية بناءً على تعليمات الشركة المصنعة. إعداد وتقديم وتوثيق وحفظ تقارير العمل بشكل دوري. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال صيانة الأجهزة الطبية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على قراءة وتتبع المخططات الفنية والكهربائية للأجهزة الطبية. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات الصيانة الوقائية والعلاجية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الأجهزة الطبية ضمن فريق متخصص في الباحة، ويساهم في الحفاظ على جاهزية وكفاءة الأجهزة الطبية في المنشآت التابعة للشركة. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بالعمل بدوام كامل.

217799f6f3d9a4ce.description: About the Role Elm Company is seeking a Senior Principal - Network & IT Security to provide expert technical leadership in the architecture, design, implementation, operation, and optimization of Elm’s enterprise network and network security environments. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and focuses on ensuring highly available, resilient, scalable, and secure network services across production, cloud, and corporate platforms. Key Responsibilities Define and enhance network architecture across production, corporate, cloud, and hybrid environments, designing scalable and resilient solutions. Design and enhance network security solutions to protect enterprise infrastructure against unauthorized access and cyber threats, applying secure network architecture principles. Provide expert engineering support for production, corporate, cloud, and hybrid network environments, including designing and implementing complex network configurations. Oversee the operation and health of critical network and network security services, analyzing incidents and driving technical resolution. Strengthen network security controls, review firewall rules and access controls, and support vulnerability assessments and remediation. Analyze network utilization, capacity, and performance to identify bottlenecks and drive technical improvements for optimization. Act as a senior subject matter expert for enterprise networking and network security, defining technical standards and providing expert advice to stakeholders. Network Operations and Optimization Provide expert technical oversight for the operation and health of critical network and network security services. Analyze complex incidents, service degradations, and recurring network issues, driving technical resolution and performing advanced root cause analysis. Identify opportunities to strengthen network availability, resilience, recoverability, and operational stability. Monitor URLs and external service availability, supporting end-to-end visibility of business-critical services. Analyze network utilization, capacity, latency, availability, and performance across enterprise environments. Identify bottlenecks, architecture limitations, and opportunities for technical optimization, defining capacity and scalability requirements. Technical Advisory and Standards Act as a senior subject matter expert for enterprise networking and network security across production, corporate, and cloud environments. Define and enhance technical standards, engineering practices, architecture guidelines, and operational documentation. Provide expert technical advice to Infrastructure, Cloud, Cybersecurity, Architecture, and other technology stakeholders. Transfer specialized technical knowledge and provide expert guidance to strengthen internal network engineering capabilities without direct people management responsibilities. Qualifications and Requirements A minimum of 10 years of experience in network and IT security roles. Demonstrated expertise in enterprise network architecture, design, implementation, and optimization. Strong background in network security solutions, including firewalls, segmentation, and secure connectivity. Proficiency in resolving complex technical challenges related to enterprise connectivity and network infrastructure. Ability to perform advanced root cause analysis and recommend corrective and preventive actions. Experience with network technology modernization and automation initiatives. Work Environment and Compliance The role requires adherence to all relevant departmental policies, processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions to ensure controlled and consistent work. Compliance with safety, quality, environmental management policies, and information security practices is essential to maintain a healthy, safe, and secure work environment, ensuring data integrity and confidentiality.

2180cdac51fd97e3.description: About the Material Analyst Early Career Training Program GE Vernova is offering a Material Analyst Early Career Training program in Dammam, Eastern region. This internship is designed for individuals with 0-1 year of experience who are looking to develop skills in materials planning, forecasting, and inventory management within a manufacturing environment. The role involves supporting daily operations to ensure material availability aligns with production schedules. Role Overview As a Materials Intern, you will contribute to the efficient flow of materials by supporting various aspects of the supply chain. This includes maintaining material data, monitoring inventory, and assisting with logistics processes. The position offers an opportunity to learn and apply ERP tools and problem-solving techniques for materials availability. Key Responsibilities Update materials Bill of Materials (BOM), Safety Stock, and Reorder Levels in the ERP system on a quarterly basis. Monitor and follow up on materials availability in coordination with the Sourcing team. Assist in the materials shipping payment process and resolve any related issues. Serve as the owner for ERP material master data integrity. Coordinate with warehouse and planning teams to resolve issues related to receiving, quantity, or documentation. Update and maintain inventory dashboards using Excel or Smartsheet. Support the preparation of materials-related documentation, reports, and compliance records. Assist the warehouse team with visual management, labeling, and layout optimization. Learn and utilize ERP tools, such as SAP, for tasks including purchase requisitions, goods receipts, and inventory movements. Engage in problem-solving for materials availability issues through planning improvement initiatives. Required Experience This internship is suitable for candidates with 0-1 year of experience, providing an entry point into materials management and supply chain operations. Work Type and Location This is an internship position located in Dammam, Eastern region. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply to join the GE Vernova team and contribute to materials planning and logistics operations.

2181681312717358.description: About the Role Bechtel Corporation is seeking a Senior Cost Engineer to join the team in Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is critical for the Ar Rjum Project, focusing on cost control, forecasting, and analysis. The role requires 5-10 years of experience in cost engineering. Project Overview The Ar Rjum Project is a greenfield gold project located within the Central Arabian Gold Region, approximately 200 km north-east of Taif towards Riyadh, and about 26 km south of Al Mouwayh. The project encompasses three open-pit mining operations with associated waste dumps and ore stockpiles, a processing plant, tailings management facilities, and supporting infrastructure including water and power supply, maintenance facilities, offices, and temporary and permanent accommodation villages. Key Responsibilities Maintain cost budgets and ensure accurate cost and cashflow forecasts, utilizing the change management system. Perform ongoing cost and cash flow analysis. Monitor contractor progress, verify monthly incurred costs, prepare monthly accruals, and provide variance analysis. Ensure that approved trends and changes are incorporated into the overall project estimate at completion (EAC) and budget for cost and quantities. Prepare routine performance reports and special studies related to assigned scope for presentation to project, corporate, and/or customer management teams. Maintain open communications with other organizations to support cost engineering analysis and control activities. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 12 to 15 years of experience in cost engineering. Demonstrated ability to prepare cost forecasts and review cost trends. Experience in implementing project requirements for cost control. Proficiency in detailed analysis to provide solutions to cost engineering challenges. Work Location This position is based in Saudi Arabia, with potential work locations including Taif, Riyadh, and Jeddah, supporting the Ar Rjum Project. Application Information Salary for this position will be disclosed during the recruitment process. We invite qualified candidates to apply.

21b0a8c3b63ba512.description: About AbbVie and the Role AbbVie is dedicated to discovering and delivering innovative medicines and solutions to address serious health issues and future medical challenges. The company focuses on therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology, neuroscience, and Allergan Aesthetics. This full-time position as a Medical Advisor Immunology is based in the Makkah Province, specifically in Jeddah or Riyadh, and requires 2-5 years of experience. Role Overview The Medical Advisor Immunology serves as the affiliate’s medical and scientific expert for assigned products and relevant therapeutic areas. This role involves providing medical and scientific advice to key customers, engaging in scientific exchange, and developing professional relationships with External Experts (EEs). The Medical Advisor will also contribute medical and scientific input to Medical Affairs strategies and commercial plans, and provide support for medical department activities under the direction of the Affiliate Medical Director. Key Responsibilities Act as an active brand team member, supporting overall strategy and execution. Provide medical and scientific input into marketing strategy and key commercial initiatives. Maintain in-depth knowledge of assigned products and therapeutic areas through continuous learning and participation in relevant events. Offer expert medical and scientific advice for assigned products, including responding to scientific and technical information requests. Contribute to the development and medical accuracy of core dossiers generated by the medical department. Establish and maintain professional relationships with External Experts (EEs) and academic centers, coordinating advisory boards and discussion forums. Deliver scientific presentations and medical education programs to healthcare professionals. Screen relevant literature and scientific society meetings, developing summaries of key messages for internal use. Deliver training to sales forces and other departments, developing and updating training materials. Design and implement clinical research projects within defined standards and budgets. Provide oversight for the review, approval, and conduct of Investigator-Initiated Studies (IIS). Support the affiliate Clinical Research Department in managing clinical studies. Review and prepare promotional and non-promotional materials, ensuring medical and scientific accuracy and compliance. Ensure adherence to all applicable national laws, regulations, guidelines, codes of conduct, and AbbVie policies. Operate as a scientific interface and resource to healthcare professionals, institutions, and professional associations. Provide specialist medical and scientific strategic input and operational support for core activities such as local clinical research and educational initiatives. Employees who are site/office-based and can occasionally perform their role virtually work both in the office and remotely, adhering to local policies and regulations. 21cf0283a6010eb9.job_title: Senior Team Manager Engineering ( Process Mechanical )
21cf0283a6010eb9.description: About Jones Engineering Jones Engineering is a leading engineering services company with over 130 years of experience in high-quality, customer-focused project delivery. Our core divisions include Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, and Sprinkler and Fire Protection. We also provide services such as Waste to Energy (BioEnergy), Specialist Lift, Off-Site Fabrication, Technical Support Services, Maintenance, Asset Management, BIM (Building Information Modelling), and Geo-Surveying. Role Overview: Mechanical Construction Manager We are seeking a Mechanical Construction Manager to join our team in Dammam, Eastern region. This full-time role requires 5-10 years of experience and involves overseeing all site construction aspects of assigned mechanical projects. The manager will be responsible for constructability reviews, schedule planning, resource management, and coordinating all on-site construction tasks to ensure installation quality from project inception to completion. This position serves as the primary point of contact for all project construction team stakeholders and involves day-to-day management of subcontractors. Key Responsibilities Report directly to the Project Manager during execution or Pre-Construction Manager during tender phases. Assist the Pre-Construction Manager, MEP Manager, and Estimating Team to ensure robust tendering processes. Critique tender documentation and pre-construction project handover documents, identify project risks, and conduct constructability studies. Review with the engineering team to ensure all take-offs align with project requirements. Prepare and manage labour forecasts, including budgets, to ensure practicality and adherence to agreed budgets. Provide discipline and construction input to the project schedule in coordination with relevant stakeholders. Prepare or contribute to subcontractor Scope of Works documentation to capture all scope and mitigate gaps. Maintain day-to-day links with client or client consultant construction discipline teams. Manage all construction activities as per scope allocation and coordinate with stakeholders to achieve project milestones. Coordinate construction work fronts with other discipline Construction Managers for efficient use of site labour and equipment. Address all construction design and execution issues in coordination with the MEP Manager and site Engineering Discipline Engineers. Track site progress, provide updates, identify schedule risks, and implement contingencies. Coordinate material take-off top-ups with engineering, procurement, and site commercial teams. Manage construction subcontractors to ensure packages meet JEG and project standards, including progress updates and performance issues. Chair weekly subcontractor coordination meetings and document minutes. Provide input to the JEG Subcontractor assessment procedure post-project handover. Coordinate with the MEP Manager and third-party plant and specialist systems suppliers to ensure suitable interfaces. Ensure construction site teams use the latest revisions of IFC documentation in coordination with relevant managers. Liaise and coordinate builders’ work requirements with site Construction stakeholders and the BIM Team. Ensure adherence to all EHS and QA/QC requirements by the team and subcontractors. Manage, coordinate, and generate red-line drawings for as-built updates and submissions. Coordinate with the QA/QC Team to ensure client representative site installation inspections are approved. Manage, coordinate, and prepare MR’s/RFQs for construction materials. Chair weekly meetings with JEG project department leads and arrange minutes. Provide detailed input to the Project Controls Engineer for weekly Progress Report development. Liaise with the commercial team to provide technical information and backup on variations. Escalate construction issues affecting project schedule or execution plans to the Line Manager. Provide input to the Project Change Management process. Handover and deliver systems to the Testing/Commissioning team, ensuring adherence to project standards. Ensure HSE requirements are observed in all construction activities. Navigate the BIM Navis model to assist with duties (training provided). Provide regular input to the continuous improvement log and implement corrective actions. Ensure awareness and compliance with QSP’s in the JEG Group Quality Library. Foster a productive, adaptive, motivated, and creative team environment. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in a relevant construction management role. Demonstrated experience in managing all site construction aspects of mechanical projects. Proven ability to manage subcontractors and coordinate with various stakeholders. Experience with constructability reviews, schedule planning, and resource management. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Dammam, Eastern region. The role involves working within a dynamic engineering services environment, collaborating with various internal teams and external stakeholders to deliver complex projects. Application Process Further details regarding the salary for this position will be disclosed during the application process.

212ae8b753b29620.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة طواف لخدمات النقل عن مدير تطوير موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى قيادة وتوجيه جهود تطوير الموارد البشرية، بما يضمن تحقيق الأهداف التنظيمية بكفاءة وفعالية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال تطوير الموارد البشرية. الهدف الرئيسي للدور يشارك مدير تطوير الموارد البشرية في وضع الأهداف والخطط والبرامج الرئيسية المتعلقة بتطوير الموارد البشرية. يشرف الدور بشكل مباشر على أنشطة إدارة الأداء والتدريب والتطوير، بالإضافة إلى أطر الجدارات وتخطيط المسارات الوظيفية وبرامج التعاقب الوظيفي. كما يتولى تنظيم أعمال تطوير الموارد البشرية ومتابعتها لضمان توافر الموارد التقنية والبشرية اللازمة لسير العمليات بأقصى كفاءة وفعالية ممكنة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تطوير الأهداف الرئيسية المتعلقة بإدارة تطوير الموارد البشرية، وتطوير وتطبيق الخطط والبرامج والمشروعات، والتأكد من وجود الأطر والمقاييس الدقيقة لمعرفة مستوى تحقيق هذه الخطط والأهداف. تطوير الخطط والبرامج والمشروعات التفصيلية المتعلقة بتطوير الموارد البشرية، بما يشمل إدارة الأداء وتدريب وتطوير المواهب وبرامج المسارات الوظيفية وبرامج الإحلال والتعاقب الوظيفي، ومتابعة عملية تنفيذها لضمان أفضل المخرجات والنتائج. الإشراف على تطبيق نظام إدارة الأداء في الجهة بجميع مراحله، وتوجيه وإدارة عملية تحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية للموظفين وإعداد خطط التدريب السنوية، وضمان تحديد أساليب التدريب والتعلم المناسبة بصورة فعالة وبالتنسيق مع مدراء الوحدات التنظيمية. تحديد احتياجات إدارة تطوير الموارد البشرية من الموارد المالية والبشرية والمستلزمات الإدارية اللازمة لتنفيذ عمليات تطوير الموارد البشرية المختلفة، بما يكفل سد احتياجات الجهة من المواهب الحالية والمستقبلية. الإشراف على عمليات إعداد وتحضير الملخصات والتقارير العامة المتعلقة بعمليات تطوير الموارد البشرية، وعرضها على الإدارة العليا، وإحاطتها بمختلف التحديات والمستجدات، واستشارتهم في مختلف القضايا والمبادرات المستقبلية المهمة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال تطوير الموارد البشرية أو دور مشابه. فهم عميق لمبادئ إدارة الأداء، وتخطيط المسارات الوظيفية، وبرامج التدريب والتطوير. القدرة على تطوير وتطبيق الخطط والبرامج الاستراتيجية. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة مكة المكرمة، المملكة العربية السعودية. يعمل شاغل الوظيفة ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تعزيز قدرات الموارد البشرية للشركة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

217b0f2581864d1f.description: About the Role Parsons Corporation is seeking a Senior Planning Engineer to join their team in Makkah, with work locations including Taif and Makkah. This full-time role involves developing and managing a comprehensive Master Schedule that integrates multiple project packages, considering their interdependencies. The primary objective is to identify and assess how changes in one package affect others, while effectively managing client expectations and ensuring timely project delivery. Key Responsibilities Develop and manage a Master Schedule that integrates multiple project packages, considering their interdependencies to assess the impact of changes across the program. Develop, implement, and maintain project controls systems and tools, ensuring compliance and resolving planning issues as they arise. Evaluate and verify planning and scheduling information, identifying potential delays and suggesting mitigation measures. Prepare regular progress reports and presentations, addressing program issues to ensure timely project completion. Assess claims, including Extension of Time and Disruption, utilizing leading delay analysis methodologies. Provide technical leadership and guidance to planning engineers, ensuring effective project controls processes and compliance. Identify potential risks and conflicts, documenting them in the Project Risk Register, and conduct "what-if" analyses to assess time impacts of changes. Coordinate and collaborate with other Senior Planning Engineers across different locations to develop a unified Master Schedule for the entire program. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in planning and scheduling roles, preferably within large-scale projects. Demonstrated experience in developing and managing complex master schedules with multiple interdependencies. Proficiency in project controls systems and tools. Experience with delay analysis methodologies for claims assessment. Strong analytical skills for risk identification and "what-if" scenario planning. 211b7fbf6fb97e50.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مصرف الراجحي عن استشاري مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقه في المنطقة الشرقية، وتحديداً في مدن الدمام، الخبر، الظهران، الجبيل، الأحساء، القطيف، راس تنورة، بقيق، الرئيسية عرض وبيع المنتجات والخدمات المصرفية للعملاء بمستوى عالٍ من الجودة والاحترافية. استقبال ومتابعة طلبات بيع المنتجات، وإدخالها وتنفيذها على النظام. مساعدة العملاء في فتح الحسابات، استيفاء المستندات، إدخال البيانات والتوقيعات، وطلب تعميد مدير العمليات. ترحيل العقود والحسابات عبر البريد إلى مركز المعلومات وعلى نظام (DMS). الترحيب بالعملاء عند دخول الفرع وتقديم الخدمة المطلوبة لهم. مساعدة العملاء في تعبئة النماذج عند الحاجة. توجيه العملاء لإتمام معاملاتهم بشكل صحيح، وتعريفهم بكيفية استخدام مكائن الصرف الآلي والقنوات الإلكترونية. توجيه العملاء إلى الموظف المختص عند الضرورة. الاستجابة السريعة لمشاكل العملاء وتلبية طلباتهم وفق الإجراءات، والمتابعة مع مراقب الفرع لحل المشكلات. استلام طلبات بطاقات الصراف الآلي، إدخالها بالنظام، طباعة البطاقات الفورية، وتسليم البطاقات المجددة. استقبال طلبات تحديث البيانات للعملاء. استلام طلبات قفل الحساب وتعديل بياناته وتسليمها لمدير العمليات. استقبال العملاء الموكلين، استكمال بيانات التوكيل، مطابقة التوقيع، وإدخاله بالنظام. استيفاء الأوامر المستديمة للعملاء، إنشاء وتنشيط العضويات، وتحويلها لمدير العمليات. التعامل مع طلبات تغيير التوقيع وتحريك الحسابات. إدخال المطالبات المتعلقة بالصراف الآلي ونقاط البيع في النظام المخصص. استقبال مشاكل العملاء وتحويلها لمدير العمليات للعمل على حلها. الاستعلام عن البطاقات الائتمانية وبطاقات الصراف الآلي المسحوبة وتوجيه العميل لاستلامها. تزويد العملاء بمنشورات المنتجات المصرفية. رفع بلاغات الاشتباه في غسل الأموال وحالات الاحتيال، والإبلاغ عن المخالفات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 1 إلى 5 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة والتعامل باحترافية. مهارات تواصل قوية وفعالة. بيئة العمل يعمل استشاري المبيعات بدوام كامل في فروع مصرف الراجحي بالمنطقة الشرقية، ضمن بيئة مصرفية ديناميكية تركز على خدمة العملاء وتحقيق الأهداف. معلومات إضافية هذا الدور متاح في عدة مدن بالمنطقة الشرقية، بما في ذلك الدمام، الخبر، الظهران، الجبيل، الأحساء، القطيف، راس تنورة، بقيق، حفر الباطن، والخفجي.

214a0c4477d231fd.description: Job description Position Summary The Head, Career Development & Experiential Learning is responsible for developing and leading KAUST’s comprehensive career development, internship, and industry engagement strategy to enhance student employability and strengthen pathways from education to meaningful career opportunities. The role provides strategic leadership for career development services supporting Saudi and international students across KAUST’s graduate and academic programs, ensuring students are equipped with the skills, networks, and experiences required to successfully transition into industry, academia, entrepreneurship, and other professional pathways. The Head will build and manage strategic relationships with Saudi industry, government entities, and key ecosystem partners to create opportunities for internships, experiential learning, and (working alongside the Office of Alumni and Graduate Employment) full-time employment for KAUST graduates. The role will also oversee visiting student engagement pathways, ensuring visiting students and participants have a high-quality KAUST experience and meaningful connections with the University. Working collaboratively with Academic Divisions, Faculty, Student Affairs, Alumni Affairs and Graduate Employment, KAUST National Transformation Institute (NTI), and external partners, this role will position KAUST as a leading institution for developing STEM talent aligned with Kingdom priorities and Vision 2030. Major Responsibilities Develop and implement a comprehensive career development strategy aligned with KAUST’s institutional priorities, Vision 2030, and workforce development needs in Saudi Arabia. Lead the design and delivery of career development programs, resources, and initiatives that support Saudi and international students throughout their KAUST journey. Establish a structured career development framework including career coaching, professional skills development, industry preparation, networking, interview preparation, and employment readiness. Work with the Office of Alumni Affairs and Graduate Employment to develop and continuously improve career programming, including workshops, employer events, career academies, and professional development initiatives. Use data, student feedback, employer insights, and employment outcomes to measure impact and enhance career services. Alongside Alumni Affairs and Graduate Employment, develop and maintain strategic relationships with Saudi industries, corporations, government entities, research organizations, and innovation ecosystems to expand career and internship opportunities for KAUST students and graduates. Build a strong employer engagement strategy to increase internship placements, graduate recruitment pipelines, and industry collaboration. Identify emerging workforce needs and collaborate with academic leaders to ensure students develop relevant skills aligned with industry expectations. Create and manage partnerships that support graduate employment opportunities, including internships, research placements, and full-time career pathways. Develop and oversee a comprehensive internship and experiential learning strategy for KAUST students. Establish processes, partnerships, and systems to increase access to high-quality internship opportunities in Saudi Arabia and internationally. Partner with faculty and and industry organizations to create meaningful applied learning experiences. Track internship participation, outcomes, employer satisfaction, and student career progression. Working with Recruitment and Admissions, lead the strategic development and management of visiting student engagement pathways, supporting both Saudi and international visiting students. Collaborate with academic divisions, admissions, student services, and external partners to ensure effective onboarding, engagement, and transition support. Work with Education & Advancement Operations Systems Team to establish career services metrics, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms to monitor engagement, internship outcomes, employment results, and employer partnerships. Prepare regular reports and recommendations for leadership regarding career outcomes and industry trends. Represent KAUST at external events, industry forums, and professional networks. Support student recruitment, orientation, commencement, and other major University activities as needed. Undertake additional responsibilities as assigned by leadership. Competencies Demonstrated ability to develop and execute strategic career development and employability programs within a higher education environment. Strong knowledge of STEM career pathways, workforce trends, and industry talent needs. Strong understanding of the Saudi higher education, industry, and innovation ecosystem. Proven experience building and managing relationships with corporate, government, and institutional partners. Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills. Ability to operate strategically while managing complex programs and initiatives. 21b0c7fbea6b10d3.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة قنبر للخرسانة الجاهزة عن مشرف مسكن للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف على التشغيل اليومي لسكن الموظفين، لضمان توفير بيئة سكنية آمنة ونظيفة ومريحة لجميع المقيمين. المسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على نظافة وتنظيم وصيانة مرافق السكن بشكل يومي. إدارة عمليات توزيع الغرف، وتسجيل الدخول والمغادرة، وترتيبات الإقامة للموظفين. متابعة مستويات النظافة والصحة في الغرف والمطابخ ودورات المياه والمرافق المشتركة. تنسيق خدمات الإعاشة، ومراقبة جودة الوجبات، والالتزام بالمواعيد، ومعايير النظافة. فحص المرافق بانتظام، ورفع طلبات الصيانة اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذها. تطبيق قواعد السكن ومتطلبات الصحة والسلامة لضمان بيئة آمنة. حفظ سجلات دقيقة لإشغال الغرف، وحالة الغرف، ونتائج الفحوصات الدورية. متابعة مخزون المواد الاستهلاكية وطلب النواقص لضمان توفرها. معالجة شكاوى المقيمين المتعلقة بالسكن، والإعاشة، والمرافق بكفاءة. التنسيق مع قسم الموارد البشرية والإدارة بشأن حركة الموظفين المقيمين. إعداد تقارير دورية عن الإشغال، والصيانة، والمخزون، والحالة العامة للسكن. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة بالإشراف على السكن أو إدارة المرافق. القدرة على الإشراف على العمليات اليومية وضمان الامتثال للمعايير. مهارات تنظيمية وإدارية جيدة. بيئة العمل يتطلب هذا الدور العمل بدوام كامل في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية، ضمن بيئة ديناميكية تركز على توفير أفضل الظروف السكنية للموظفين. معلومات إضافية الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه. التقديم إذا كنت تستوفي المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه، ندعوك للتقديم على هذا الدور في شركة قنبر للخرسانة الجاهزة.

21f441ba27d8338d.description: About the Role GREENLAND GROUP is seeking a Firewatch / Hole Watch for AYTB SA in Saudi Arabia. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess practical experience in safety monitoring and emergency response within industrial settings. 2-5 years of experience in a Firewatch or Hole Watch role. Demonstrated understanding of fire hazards and safety protocols. Proficiency in monitoring confined spaces and managing entry/exit procedures. Required Skills Strong observational skills to detect fire hazards, gas leaks, and unsafe conditions. Effective communication skills for coordinating with workers and reporting incidents.
